title: Record
intro: Photos and videos you take here are fingerprinted and signed on your phone, as a record for you and your lawyer.

capture.cameraPermissionBody: To record evidence, Saakshi needs your camera. Photos and videos stay on your phone.
capture.micPermissionBody: Videos record sound too, so Saakshi needs your microphone.

locker.heading: Your records
locker.missing: This record is no longer on your phone.
locker.checkOkBody: Every file still matches its signed record, and the records are in an unbroken chain.
locker.checkProblemBody_one: {{count}} problem was found. A file or record has changed or is missing since it was recorded.
locker.checkProblemBody_other: {{count}} problems were found. A file or record has changed or is missing since it was recorded.
locker.chainHeadHelp: The SHA-256 of the last signed record. It covers every file above.
locker.deleteBody_one: This deletes {{count}} file, its signed record and any certificate from this phone. It can't be undone. Copies you have already exported or sent are not affected.
locker.deleteBody_other: This deletes {{count}} files, their signed records and any certificate from this phone. It can't be undone. Copies you have already exported or sent are not affected.
locker.deleteBusy: This record is still being saved. Try again when recording has stopped.
locker.itemInterrupted: Cut off before it was stopped (the app closed or the phone switched off). It plays up to the cut, and was sealed when the app next opened.

witness.help: Sends this record's fingerprint, time and place by SMS to people you choose, so that others hold it from today.
witness.title: Saakshi evidence record

certificate.title: Certificate, Part A
certificate.intro: This fills in Part A of the certificate that section 63(4)(c) of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 asks for when electronic records are produced in court, with the hash report attached. The phone's make, model and the SHA-256 of each file are filled in for you.
certificate.partB: The certificate also needs Part B, filled in and signed by an expert. This app cannot provide Part B.
certificate.name: Your full name
certificate.relativeName: Name of your parent or spouse
certificate.imeiHint: Dial *#06# on this phone to see it. If it shows two, enter both, separated by a comma.
certificate.ownership: This phone is, by you (tick all that apply):
certificate.serialHint: Usually in Settings, under About phone.
certificate.signByHand: Print the certificate, then sign it and write the date, time and place by hand.
certificate.required: Fill in your name, your parent's or spouse's name, address and IMEI, and tick at least one box.
certificate.madeBody: It is saved with this record and goes into the bundle when you export it.

grounds.text: “Please tell me the grounds of my arrest, and give them to me in writing.”
grounds.why: Police must tell you why you are arrested, and give it to you in writing in a language you understand, at the latest two hours before you are taken to a magistrate for remand.
grounds.source: Constitution Art. 22(1); BNSS s.47(1); Mihir Rajesh Shah v. State of Maharashtra (SC, 2025), para 56

name.why: An officer making an arrest must wear clear, visible identification of their name.

inform.text: “Please tell [name] that I have been arrested and where I am being held.”
inform.why: Police must tell a relative, friend or other person you name, and must tell you that you have this right.

lawyer.why: You have the right to consult a lawyer of your choice, and to meet them during questioning, though not for all of it.

bail.why: If it is, police must tell you that you can be released on bail.

calm.text: Stay calm, keep your distance, and don't obstruct or resist.
calm.why: Obstructing a public servant, and resisting a lawful arrest, are offences.

statement.text: Say the date, time and place out loud.
statement.why: It helps anyone who watches the recording later.

bodycam.title: Body-cam mode
bodycam.openHint: Wear the phone and keep your hands free. It records video continuously, in one-minute pieces, each fingerprinted and signed as it is saved.
bodycam.intro: Wear the phone on your chest, round your neck or clipped to your clothes. It records video continuously and saves it in one-minute pieces, each fingerprinted and signed as it is saved. The screen goes dark and touch is locked while it records.
bodycam.unlockBody: While body-cam mode records, the screen is dark and doesn't respond to touch. To unlock it, press the volume-down button twice, quickly. Practise this before you need it.
bodycam.unlockAck: I know how to unlock it
bodycam.ackFirst: First read how to unlock the screen, above.
bodycam.iosWarning: On iPhone, video records only while Saakshi is on screen. If you leave the app, or a call comes in, video stops and sound keeps recording. Video starts again when you come back.
bodycam.androidNote: Recording carries on if you turn the screen off, take a call or use other apps.
bodycam.batteryAndroid: Turn on Battery Saver before you start: body-cam mode keeps the camera running.
bodycam.batteryIos: Turn on Low Power Mode before you start, in Control Centre or Settings > Battery: body-cam mode keeps the camera running.
bodycam.locked: Screen locked. Use your unlock buttons.
bodycam.notificationText: Body-cam mode. Open Saakshi to stop.
